title: Delta under a moving volatility smile
prompt: All figures and markets in this question are synthetic. Black-Scholes prices a call at each spot. For an instantaneous move, remaining maturity and rates stay fixed; implied volatility follows sigma(S)=sigma0+eta*ln(S/S0). Compute frozen-vol delta, total spot derivative along this rule, new volatility at the specified spot, and exact mark-to-model P&L of one call hedged initially with minus the total delta shares. No time passes and there are no costs or financing cash flows.

outputs.name: frozen_delta
outputs.description: Black-Scholes spot delta with sigma fixed.

outputs.name: hedged_pnl
outputs.description: Exact call repricing plus initial stock hedge P&L.
